import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-864578d8.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    colors = [row[0] for row in grid if row[0] != 0]
    n = len(grid)
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The horizontal marker rows define a repeating sequence; repeated adjacent
    # markers are part of the sequence only once.
    seq = []
    for c in colors:
        if not seq or seq[-1] != c:
            seq.append(c)
    return [[seq[r % len(seq)]] * len(grid[0]) for r in range(n)]
''')
# execute actual saved transform
ns={}; exec(p.read_text(),ns)
g=[[5]*28]+[[0]*28 for _ in range(3)]+[[3]*28]+[[0]*28 for _ in range(15)]+[[7]*28]+[[0]*28 for _ in range(7)]
out=ns['transform'](g)
print(len(out), [r[0] for r in out])
